value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"A hinge-component supplier for Apple's first foldable was asked last week to \"hold\" part of its November shipments while Apple re-tests a revised hinge geometry.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"hinge-component shipments for foldable","period":"November","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"The hold was described as 2-3 weeks, and not a cancellation.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"hinge-component shipment hold duration","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"Nobody he spoke to expected a launch-date change, but the initial build for the November-December period could be trimmed by a low-to-mid-single-digit percentage of the plan.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"initial foldable build","period":"November-December","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":"down","first_hand":false},{"quote":"Street numbers for the foldable are small relative to the total iPhone line-up (we model low-single-digit millions of units in the Dec quarter), so even a trim wouldn't matter much for AAPL EPS.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"foldable unit estimate impact on EPS","period":"Dec quarter","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
